card.name: Ancient era names in history text
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside names of ancient eras and Indian or Iranian history terms, such as 'during' before Kali Yuga, or 'the' before Early Iron Age. Also fires on scattered mid-name pieces in lists.

modes.label: Before era names
modes.description: Linking words like 'during' or 'the' right before a named historical age or yuga.
modes.example: and it enters the historical record during<< the>> Early Iron Age.

modes.label: Inside Sanskrit names
modes.description: Partway through names like Chaturyuga or Asamanjas.
modes.example: Sagara indeed had a son named<< As>>amanjas who was rejected by people.

modes.label: Scattered list pieces
modes.description: Odd spots inside dates, numbers or herbal formula names.

card.plain: It lights up on small words and name pieces just before ancient eras or Sanskrit names in history writing.
